notes.title: DonDon Revisited!!
notes.notes:
After over a year since release, a lot has happened in both the world and our personal lives. It was time to do a little update for this game, and here it is! I'll make no promises on when and what future updates will contain, but this game still has more to give!

Included in this update is:

[b]A new set of stages, Intermediate stages!! [/b]
Previously there were Basic, Advanced and Master stages, and now there's a new
stage difficulty for each environment, aimed at players starting to get the hang of the
basics, and want something just a bit more challenging. This means that
the game now has 20 stages!

[b]All stages revamped and redecorated!![/b]
All the 15 stages that were previously in the game have received various updates
based on feedback and play testing. They are now more varied and better balanced.
In addition they've all been thoroughly decorated (they were embarrassingly bare previously)
to make them more lively, as well as having the colors slightly modified to further
enhance visibility.

[b]Effects changes!![/b]
Several effects have been changed to provide more clarity to game play,
and a very subtle outline was re-added to the characters.

[b]Fixes!![/b]
Several small fixes, most notably related to various audio channels.


Since their update, remote play together is working even better than before,
and if you're looking for online opponents, the best place to ask is in the discord:

https://discord.gg/rWQCEYH


That's it!!

Hope you enjoy!!
